verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is an AI-driven solution that automatically optimizes payments to raise acceptance rates. That is a background optimization feature, not AI-generated insights or suggestions shown to the user inside the product. Nothing in the pack documents an AI assistant, insight surface, or recommendations drawn from the merchant's data, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically optimize payments to increase your acceptance rate with our powerful AI-driven solution.
